apps.name: Glance
apps.subtitle: Your feeds, one dashboard
apps.localizedDescription: A personal intelligence dashboard for iOS. Aggregates Real Madrid fixtures and match timeline, Pokémon GO raids and events, GitHub Trending, AI/ML news with on-device summaries, and any custom RSS feed into a single dark-mode card feed.

permissions.usageDescription: Fetches your feeds, fixtures and articles.
Refreshes feeds in the background so data stays current.
